decisions.question: Which ACS adult-population vintage should weight both 2024 and 2026 cost distributions?
decisions.why_it_matters: Changing weights between vintages confounds cost change with population-mix change.
decisions.option_a: Freeze 2024 ACS 5-Year adult 18+ for both cost years (implemented as the current candidate).
decisions.option_c: Use a different vintage for each cost year.
decisions.directional_effect: Holds geography mix constant so 2024 vs 2026 cost movement is a cost change.
decisions.source_support: Census ACS 5-Year B01001 official summary file acsdt5y2024-b01001.dat.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: Recompute state ranks with 2023 ACS weights after owner approval.

decisions.question: Which MEPS OOP statistic is the headline healthcare utilization amount?
decisions.why_it_matters: Mean is pulled by high spenders; median is more typical; P75 is a stress case.
decisions.option_a: Weighted mean among adults 18-64 with private insurance.
decisions.option_b: Weighted median among the same population.
decisions.option_c: Publish mean as primary with median/P75 sensitivity.
decisions.source_support: MEPS HC-251 2023 Full Year Consolidated (newest official FY file; 2024 FY due later).
decisions.sensitivity_plan: Report mean, median, P75 once microdata parse is validated.

decisions.question: Is observed NHTS mileage the living-cost mileage, or is a lower minimum-necessary mileage required?
decisions.why_it_matters: Observed 1-person/1-worker households travel far more than a commuting-only floor.
decisions.option_a: Use measured NHTS weighted mean/median as mobility requirement.
decisions.option_b: Define a separate MINIMUM NECESSARY MILEAGE assumption below observed travel.
decisions.option_c: Use NHTS P25 as a conservative observed standard.
decisions.recommended: C pending owner review; do not treat observed mean as 'necessary'.
decisions.directional_effect: Observed mean (~19,400 mi in current extract) raises transportation vs P25.
decisions.source_support: 2022 NHTS V2.1 hhv2pub+vehv2pub; ANNMILES; WTHHFIN; HHSIZE=1; WRKCOUNT=1.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: Publish P25/median/mean/P75 of observed miles; owner picks headline.

decisions.question: What is the reference used vehicle and EPA combined MPG?
decisions.why_it_matters: MPG scales fuel cost. 28 MPG in code is unsupported.
decisions.option_a: EPA compact/midsize used-car combined MPG near the fleet median.
decisions.option_b: Keep 28 MPG as ESTIMATED until EPA table is frozen.
decisions.option_c: Use a documented specific model-year compact sedan.
decisions.recommended: A after EPA table extract; until then ESTIMATED_OWNER_REVIEW.
decisions.source_support: EPA fueleconomy.gov public data; not yet frozen.

decisions.question: How should the vehicle replacement reserve be set?
decisions.why_it_matters: The $1,600 path (10k-2k)/5 is normative, not measured.
decisions.option_a: Acquisition minus salvage over usable years, all assumptions listed.
decisions.option_b: BLS CE vehicle-purchase P25 among single-person units annualized.
decisions.option_c: No reserve until owner approves a formula.
decisions.recommended: A as ESTIMATED_OWNER_REVIEW; do not publish $1,600 as measured.
decisions.directional_effect: Shorter life or higher acquisition raises annual reserve.
decisions.source_support: None measured. Retired prototype used 10k/5yr/2k salvage.

decisions.question: What public source replaces licensed NAIC auto-insurance averages?
decisions.why_it_matters: Insurance is mandatory where auto is the baseline.
decisions.option_a: Licensed NAIC Auto Insurance Database Report if owner supplies artifact.
decisions.option_b: State DOI public average-premium tables where they exist.
decisions.option_c: Leave LICENSING_REVIEW / SOURCE_GAP; no commercial quote sites.
decisions.recommended: C until a reusable public series is inventoried.
decisions.source_support: NAIC is licensed. No fabricated content.naic.org CSV.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: If owner licenses NAIC, ingest once with honest provenance.

decisions.question: What is the maintenance + tires + repairs standard?
decisions.option_a: BLS CE vehicle-maintenance/tires P25 among single-person positive spenders.
decisions.option_b: Keep a labeled ESTIMATED reserve until CE parse is approved.
decisions.option_c: Split ordinary maintenance, tires, and repairs if CE UCC codes support it.
decisions.recommended: A+C after CE variables are verified against the official dictionary.
decisions.directional_effect: P25 is below mean maintenance spend.
decisions.source_support: BLS CE 2024 Interview PUMD (intrvw24.zip) retrieved and FMLI parsed.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: P20/P25/P30 on vehicle-maintenance/tires UCC codes after dictionary freeze.

decisions.question: Which recreation percentile is the headline Social & Recreation amount?
decisions.why_it_matters: Recreation must stay nonzero and modest.
decisions.option_a: Weighted P25 among single-person positive spenders.
decisions.recommended: A; publish P20/P25/P30 for review and do not freeze one.
decisions.source_support: BLS CE Interview PUMD documented UCC/FMLI allowlist.

decisions.question: What is the minimum connectivity standard?
decisions.why_it_matters: Zero internet is not a sustainable adult life.
decisions.option_a: One prepaid/postpaid mobile line + one residential broadband plan at a documented low-cost official series.
decisions.recommended: A as Foundation minimum-service selection, not a measured typical bill.
decisions.directional_effect: Adding both line and broadband raises connectivity.
decisions.source_support: FCC Urban Rate Survey / ACS computer-internet tables are candidates; not frozen.

decisions.question: How should lagging 2026 structural sources be translated?
decisions.option_a: LATEST_AVAILABLE for structural survey files; RULE_YEAR for tax; YTD for monthly prices.
decisions.option_c: Refuse 2026 costs until every source has a 2026 observation.
decisions.recommended: A with explicit project_cost_year / source_data_year / translation_method on every component.
decisions.directional_effect: CPI-updating raises 2026 vs holding latest available.

decisions.question: How should municipal earned-income taxes that do not map to county geography be handled?
decisions.why_it_matters: NYC and Philadelphia are not statewide.
decisions.option_a: Attach tax only to counties that contain the taxing city; other counties UNAVAILABLE for local tax.
decisions.option_b: Ignore municipal taxes until a place-level geography is authorized.
decisions.option_c: Invent a statewide average local tax.
decisions.directional_effect: A raises living cost only in affected counties.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: Compare county results with and without municipal overlay.

decisions.question: Is an additional resilience reserve required after vehicle/health/clothing replacement is already annualized?
decisions.why_it_matters: An extra 5%/10%/$1,200 buffer double-counts if replacement is already inside components.
decisions.option_a: No extra reserve until a documented uncovered irregular cost is identified.
decisions.option_b: Add a small ESTIMATED reserve after an overlap audit.
decisions.directional_effect: Any extra reserve raises gross required income.
decisions.source_support: GROK.MD resilience section; retired buffers are not authorized.

decisions.question: How should Connecticut ACS planning regions be joined to HUD county FMR rows?
decisions.why_it_matters: 2024 ACS 5-Year uses Connecticut planning-region FIPS (09110-09170). HUD FMR still publishes legacy county FIPS. Nine ACS geographies (about 2.9 million adults) currently unmatched.
decisions.option_a: Build an official CT OPM/Census crosswalk from planning regions to legacy counties and allocate FMR.
decisions.option_b: Leave CT unmatched until HUD publishes planning-region FMR.
decisions.option_c: Assign a statewide CT 1BR FMR to unmatched planning regions.
decisions.recommended: A if an official crosswalk exists; otherwise B. Never invent county rents.
decisions.directional_effect: B excludes ~1.1% of national adult population from the housing join.
decisions.sensitivity_plan: Recompute CT after an official crosswalk is frozen.
